I have farmed this small plot for many years, and I know what my soil needs. My family helps me because my hands are not as strong as they once were, and together we work the land with hoes the way my mother taught me. We save our own maize seed from the last harvest, and we spread cattle manure on the field to keep it fertile, but we do not have money to buy fertilizer or chemicals from the shops. The rains in Iringa have always been good enough for our maize, so we rely on them and do not irrigate.
